label: The D-frontier
subgoals: Place the primitive D-cube of failure at the fault site
List gates with an X output and a D or D-bar input as the D-frontier
Backtrack when the D-frontier empties before an output carries the error

label: The J-frontier
subgoals: Mark assigned lines whose gates do not yet imply them
Collect those gates as the J-frontier
Imply forced values forward and backward after each assignment

label: Search and completeness
subgoals: Stop when an output carries the error and the J-frontier is empty
Backtrack to the last decision with an untried alternative on a conflict
Prove untestability by exhausting every alternative
